name: bisection-debugging
description: A principal-engineer-level curriculum on bisection debugging. Single-file HTML, all code blocks extract to runnable scripts under scripts/.

scripts.clean: rm -rf scripts/foundations scripts/git-bisect scripts/file-bisect scripts/dep-build scripts/test-perf scripts/bash scripts/zsh scripts/ci scripts/advanced
scripts.prepare: node -e "console.log('Ready. \"npm run dev\" serves the curriculum at http://localhost:8080. \"npm run build\" escapes HTML, extracts every code block to scripts/, and syntax-checks all of them.')"
